title: SEC-004: Replace alert() with inline error display
description: Using browser alert() for error messages is poor UX and potentially exposes sensitive error details. Replacing with inline component error display improves user experience and reduces information leakage.

context.issue: Browser alert is blocking and exposes error details

acceptance_criteria: Remove alert() call from error handler
Add installError ref to component state
Add error display in template using v-if
Error message is visible but non-blocking
User can dismiss error or retry download

implementation_notes.finally_handler: Clear downloadingInstaller state in finally block
implementation_notes.styling: Use Bootstrap alert-danger class or custom error styling
implementation_notes.placement: Display error near download button or in modal

unit_test: Verify error is set to installError state
component_test: Verify error message displays in UI
Verify error message is readable and styled appropriately
manual_test: Block network (DevTools Network > Offline) or mock error
Try clicking download again after error

rollback_plan: git revert <commit-hash> — UX improvement, safe to revert
notes: This is a UX improvement that removes blocking browser alert and provides inline error feedback. It's marked LOW severity because alert() still works, but inline error is better practice. Low priority for merging but good to include in this batch.
